modalities.evidence: T1 weighted images from 30 participant adults
the data included in this set is only T1 and DWI

output.population: 30 participant adults: 15 monolingual English speakers and 15 multilinguals
output.summary: Structural T1-weighted and diffusion-weighted brain images from monolingual English speakers and highly proficient multilingual speakers, collected on a 3T Skyra scanner to study brain differences associated with multilingualism.
